ms.label: 4(a)
ms.text:
one mark each for any two of:
•
has a definite shape / does not take the shape of the container
•
has a definite volume / fixed volume
•
does not spread over surface / does not flow

ms.label: 4(c)
ms.text:
solid tin
separation: touching / close together (1)
motion: vibrating (1)
liquid tin
separation: close together (1)
motion: sliding (over each other) OR moving over each other (1)
